case_name: Over budget or beyond the free tier
title: Estimate Exceeds Hard Credit Budget
tests: Checks that an over-budget estimate produces a clear budget warning and no generation, rather than an unauthorized cheaper substitute.

got.question:
I didn't make the clip. The estimate you saw is 90 credits, which is three times your 30-credit limit, so I stopped as you asked. Nothing was made and no credits were spent.

If you want to try another way, here are two options. I'd need you to approve either one before I start:

must_haves.item: The response states that the 90-credit estimate exceeds the 30-credit budget.
must_haves.why: The agent said the 90-credit estimate is three times the 30-credit limit.

must_haves.item: The response clearly says generation has not started.
must_haves.why: The agent said "I didn't make the clip" and "Nothing was made," and repeated this in the final reply.

must_haves.item: No clip or substitute asset is delivered.
must_haves.why: No asset was produced. The alternatives were only offered for approval, and the agent dropped them when the user declined.

reply.summary: The agent stopped because the estimate was over budget, stated the cost conflict clearly, delivered nothing, and respected the user's refusal of alternatives.
